name: Notocolossus
sum: Notocolossus is a giant titanosaur from the Plottier Formation of Mendoza, Argentina, known from two partial skeletons.
wsnote: No body-size figure was read in the sources consulted.
holotype: UNCUYO-LD 301, from the Plottier Formation about 86 Ma.
material: A second partial skeleton without the skull (UNCUYO-LD 302), from a smaller individual.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
author: González Riga et al. 2016
